name: pixel-legions
description: Pixel Legions: an HD-2D, Total War-style battle game for friends (browser, Windows + Mac)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sim && tsc -p packages/net && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p packages/worker && tsc -p tools
scripts.check: npm run check:det && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @pl/worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @pl/worker
